name: task-router
description: Managed model routing from Codex conversation with background execution and durable task status

interface.shortDescription: Submit, track and resume model tasks in Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds conversation tools for submitting authorized tasks, waiting for results, cancellation and recovery. A packaged background controller persists tasks and manages model attempts. The host classifies and submits requests; this does not recover a host model that fails before submission.
